sections.title: What is a reflexive verb?
sections.content: A reflexive verb describes an action that the subject performs on themselves. In the dictionary, reflexive verbs end in **-se** (such as *levantarse*). When conjugating, you must place the matching reflexive pronoun before the verb.

items.spanish: Yo me levanto a las siete de la mañana.
items.english: I get up at seven in the morning.
What time do you take a shower?

items.spanish: Carlos se lava la cara con agua fría.
items.english: Carlos washes his face with cold water.
What time do you all get up?

sections.content: In Spain, informal plural you (*vosotros / vosotras*) uses the reflexive pronoun **os**: *¿A qué hora os levantáis?* Formal plural (*ustedes*) uses **se**: *¿Ustedes se levantan temprano?*
